PURPOSE
Turn hypotheses, unknowns, and likely causes into neutral, traceable client questions.

OWNER
GRETEL TRACK B

INPUT CONTRACT
Accumulated payload with hypotheses[], unknowns[], diagnoses[]

OUTPUT CONTRACT
Accumulated payload plus validation_questions[] conforming to validation_question.schema.json

STATUS
Phase 2B repository-ready. Inactive by default. No credentials. Deterministic fixture path; no Python execution.

VISIBLE PATH
Hypothesis / unknown / likely cause -> validation gap -> neutral question -> leading-language check -> traceability check -> question output.
Every emitted question links to a finding and hypothesis.
